text: Milo Manara's Click was banned in New Zealand in 1991 by the Indecent Publications Tribunal. The decision was registered on 1991-04-30 (IPT 91-6). The Classification Office's list of books banned by the Tribunal, released in November 2020, records no later classification, so the ban is in force.
meta_description: Milo Manara's Click was banned in New Zealand in 1991 by the Indecent Publications Tribunal, and the ban is recorded as still in force.
